Why does a stablecoin stay worth about $1?
About $305B in stablecoins existed as of September 2026 (DefiLlama).
Big issuers hold mostly cash and T-bills; approved traders redeem coins under $1 and mint coins over $1, pulling the price back.
Issuers earn the interest: Circle reported $668M of reserve income in Q2 2026.
When backing is in doubt, pegs slip: USDC fell to about 87 cents in March 2023 with $3.3B stuck at SVB; algorithmic TerraUSD sank to about a penny in 2022.
Sources: DefiLlama, Circle Q2 2026 results, Axios, CoinDesk.
News and education, not financial advice.
